approval_evidence.quote: This new drug application provides for the use of Motegrity (prucalopride) oral tablets for chronic idiopathic constipation. (FDA approval letter, NDA 210166, signed 12/14/2018)

series_start_reason: Takeda prints a Resolor/Motegrity product line only from fiscal Q4 FY2018 (January-March 2019), the first quarter after it completed the Shire acquisition; earlier history (Shire, USD, different issuer) was not sourced in this batch and is not spliced.
series_end_reason: Takeda's quarterly financial report for FY2026 Q1 (April-June 2026; qr2026_q1_qfr_en.pdf) contains no RESOLOR/MOTEGRITY line (zero text lines mention Resolor or Motegrity), whereas the FY2025 Q4 report prints it (RESOLOR/MOTEGRITY FY2025 7.3 billion JPY). The GI table of the FY2026 Q1 report lists 'Others' rows instead.
notes: Printed label is 'Resolor/Motegrity' (FY2019) / 'RESOLOR/MOTEGRITY' (later): ex-U.S. and U.S. brand names of prucalopride on one worldwide line. No launch quarter is cited.
search_log: downloaded takeda.com quarterly-results pages for 2012-2025 and the current page (15 pages) and collected every PDF/XLSX link (cache/takeda_links.json)
scanned every qr20xx_q?/full PDF on those pages with pdftotext for the product labels, then read the matching pages with pdfplumber (the verifier's extractor) so quoted figures match its text layer

FY2014 (JGAAP) documents carry no Entyvio table line for Q1/Q2; FY2015 onward are IFRS; the product-table pages were located per fiscal quarter (data books FY2016-FY2019, quarterly financial reports FY2020-FY2026)

EDGAR (Takeda CIK 0001395064) was indexed through data.sec.gov submissions (6-K, 6-K/A, 20-F, 20-F/A) but the takeda.com copies of the same quarterly documents were cited instead, because the 6-K earnings exhibits were not individually resolved
cross-check: for every fiscal year the four quarterly values were summed and compared with the full-year product figure printed in the Q4 document (differences at most 0.2 billion JPY from rounding)
checked qr2026_q1_qfr_en.pdf for any line mentioning Resolor or Motegrity: none
